writing.overall_comment: A well-structured, semantically accurate handover skill whose main weakness is the absence of edge-case and failure-path examples.

dimensions.name: Semantic accuracy
dimensions.comment: The name and description accurately capture the skill's purpose of producing a session handover summary with tasks, decisions, and next steps, matching the body's format and responsibilities.

dimensions.name: Examples & edge cases
dimensions.comment: The handover template serves as a concrete example, but there is no coverage of failure paths such as empty sessions, blocked or incomplete work, or how to handle missing context.

dimensions.name: Actionability
dimensions.comment: The responsibilities and output format are clear and executable, though steps like 'Generate Handover Prompt' (missing article) are slightly vague and lack guidance on prioritization or length limits.

suggestions: [structure] body is ~246 words; aim for at least 250 → expand thin sections with concrete detail
Add explicit failure-path examples to the handover template for empty sessions, blocked or incomplete work, and missing context, specifying how the agent should respond in each case.
Add prioritization and length-limit guidance to the output format or responsibilities so the handover prompt tells the agent what to include first and how concise to be.
